Date: Tue, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redline + SCCs mapping for ClearCloud order form

Hi Sergio —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our first-pass DPA redline (Draft_DPA_Redline_v3.docx) and an SCCs mapping table that our privacy team prepared (SCCs_Mapping_Table.xlsx). High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm whether Redwood will accept the proposed roles table (we currently show Redwood as processor; ClearCloud will remain controller).
- Please confirm whether Redwood can sign the Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) language in section 4.2, or whether you require an alternate approach (SSC + contractual safeguards).
- We also want to align on order form fields that trigger cross-border routing / encryption requirements so our procurement team can price appropriately.

Can we schedule a 30-min alignment call this week? We’re flexible Thursday or Friday morning CET.

Attachments: Draft_DPA_Redline_v3.docx, SCCs_Mapping_Table.xlsx

Best,
Anna Schmidt
Legal Counsel — ClearCloud
anna.schmidt@clearcloud.io

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redline + SCCs mapping for ClearCloud order form

Anna — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. Quick read-through and initial notes below; we can take the rest on the call.

1) Roles: Redwood is generally comfortable documented as a processor for the hosting/inference service. Our standard wording clarifies that for telemetry/ops data we act as processor; for customer-provided prompts and outputs, Redwood processes per customer direction. If ClearCloud needs controller/processor split language in the DPA, we can propose a short exhibit clarifying data categories.

2) Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA): our privacy team prefers to keep the SCCs + contractual safeguards approach rather than a standalone TIA where possible. That said, we can accept a narrowly-scoped TIA for EU->US routing if it ties to specific subprocessor controls and KMS obligations. Ben, can legal prep that scoped TIA language?

3) Order form triggers: can procurement confirm which fields drive cross-border obligations (region of data residency vs. routing preference vs. export controls)? If we get a mapping, ops can estimate additional costs.

I can do Thu 09:00 CET / Thu 15:00 PST or Fri 08:00 CET. If those times don't work, propose two options.

Call notes link (will populate before meeting): https://drive.redwood.ai/clearcloud/dpa-draft

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: DPA redline + SCCs mapping for ClearCloud order form

Sergio / Anna / Laura —

Looping in procurement. Two quick clarifications from our side before the call:

- Order form draft attached (ClearCloud_OrderForm_Draft.pdf). We currently model data residency as a checkbox that toggles an EU-only routing add-on; if routed to non-EU regions there is a price uplift and additional audit obligations.
- Which campaign or product line will be on the initial order? (we need SKU to map pricing).
- We also need to understand what levels of audit evidence Redwood can provide (SOC2 Type II cert + export control runbook?).

We can meet Fri 09:00 CET if that works for Redwood.

Regards,
ClearCloud Procurement

Procurement Team — ClearCloud

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@clearcloud.io>, ClearCloud Procurement <procurement@clearcloud.io>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2026 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redline + SCCs mapping for ClearCloud order form

Anna / procurement —

Thanks for the materials. Quick legal read:

- Section references are to your Draft_DPA_Redline_v3.docx. We propose the following high-level edits we can take live as a shared redline before the call:
  * Section 2 (roles): add a short exhibit A that enumerates "Data categories" and ties those categories to controller/processor roles (we'll draft).
  * Section 4.2 (TIA / Transfer safeguards): delete the blanket customer responsibility language and replace with a narrowly scoped TIA clause that: (i) limits scope to cross-border routing initiated by ClearCloud order form fields, (ii) requires subprocessor attestations for the specific hosting regions, and (iii) requires Redwood to provide key-rotation evidence on customer request.
  * SCCs: we'll accept the standard EU SCCs with an additional annex referencing our KMS controls and audit rights; we'll provide the annex language.

- Evidence: Redwood can provide SOC2 Type II (latest report), a summary of our subprocessor list, and an operations runbook describing export-control checks. We will not share raw logs by default; logs can be exported under an agreed evidentiary request process.

- Procurement asks: if the Order Form routing checkbox will cause Redwood to designate extra isolation capacity, pricing should include a monthly isolation uplift (estimate: +18–25% depending on region). Ops will provide a firm estimate after onboarding SKU.

I've attached an editable redline (Draft_DPA_Redline_v3_BC.docx) with inline suggestions. Can someone confirm receipt?

Ben Carter
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Thanks all — summary and next steps below (per Ben’s redline and procurement notes):

Agreed points (pre-call):

- Redwood legal will prepare a scoped TIA clause limited to order-form-driven routing and tied to subprocessor attestations (Ben / Karthik).
- Redwood will provide SOC2 Type II report, a subprocessor list, and an ops runbook excerpt as evidence; raw logs available on request under an evidentiary procedure.
- Procurement: ClearCloud to share SKU for initial order so Redwood Ops can provide a firm isolation/pricing uplift.

Action items / owners / ETA:

- Ops (Laura): produce isolation uplift estimate after SKU received (ETA: 2 business days after SKU).
- Anna / ClearCloud Procurement: share SKU and confirm Fri 09:00 CET call or propose alt time (ETA: Fri 2026-05-22 12:00 CET).
- Sergio: draft meeting agenda + populate Drive link (https://drive.redwood.ai/clearcloud/dpa-draft).

Proposed meeting: Fri 09:00 CET — please confirm. Once we have confirmation I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a shared Google doc for live redlines. We’ll plan to close the DPA redline + TIA scope in the week of 25 May if possible.

Thanks — looking forward to wrapping this up.
